A '''[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]''' was kidnapped by [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith]] forces and brought to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Odacer-Faustin]], where the they were to be sacrificed as part of a ritual intended to grant [[Immortality/Legends|immortality]] to the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Drear]]. Drear had intended to cut out the Jedi's [[Heart/Legends|heart]] using a [[Darth Drear's Sith sword|sword]] and consume the organ to complete the immortality ritual, but the Jedi's [[Blood/Legends|blood]] possessed an insufficient amount of [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|midi-chlorians]] to make the ritual successful. Drear [[Death/Legends|perished]] as a result of the failure.
